issues.basis: NL1; inspection_equivalent_facts.reachability [*]->[llms_emp_feedback_final_0014,UnspecifiedInitial]; inspection_equivalent_facts.states state:DoorsClosing:line:10 reachable_from_initial false; verify_facts check reachability:state:DoorsClosing:line:10 refuted
issues.expected: Root initial pseudostate entry targets DoorsClosing so the system starts in DoorsClosing.
issues.observed: Root initial transition [*]->UnspecifiedInitial transition:line:34 is reachable; state:DoorsClosing:line:10 is unreachable_from_initial and has no top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: Canonical IR initial_states lists InMotion.Accelerating and inspection_equivalent_facts reachability shows only root and UnspecifiedInitial reachable; DoorsClosing is STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL.
issues.requirement_quote: The system starts in the DoorsClosing state and transitions to InMotion when the doors are closed, triggered by the "Closed/SendDeparted" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: DoorsClosing could be reached via an alternate root entry path not captured in the finite reachability facts.
issues.title: System initial entry is not DoorsClosing

issues.basis: NL5; exact_source_inventory.transition tr_0002 source @initial:InMotion target InMotion.Accelerating event Entry/Accelerate; inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions transition:line:15 triggers [Entry_Accelerate]; diagnostics INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL line 15
issues.expected: Owner InMotion has an unconditional default entry to substate Accelerating.
issues.observed: InMotion initial transition [*]->Accelerating transition:line:15 carries trigger Entry_Accelerate and is flagged INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL; verify_facts initial-entry:transition:line:15 refuted with has_trigger true.
issues.reason: Contract requires InMotion begins in Accelerating; model provides an initial entry but it is trigger-carrying, not an unconditional default entry.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate, moving to the Cruising substate once cruising speed is reached, as indicated by the "Reached Cruising/Cruise" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: A conditional entry with the correct trigger could be interpreted as the required begin-in Accelerating behavior.
issues.title: InMotion initial entry to Accelerating is conditional with trigger

issues.basis: NL3; exact_source_inventory.states EmergencyStopping source_id EmergencyStopping; exact_source_inventory.states EmergencyStopping.Entry source_id EmergencyStopping.Entry; fcstm_model state EmergencyStopping named "EmergencyStopping\n[PlantUML body] Obstacle Detected" with child Entry
issues.expected: State EmergencyStopping includes action Emergency Stop.
issues.observed: FCSTM model contains composite EmergencyStopping with child Entry state; no state action is declared for EmergencyStopping and the Entry child has no action fact.
issues.reason: Source inventory shows EmergencyStopping composite with child Entry, but closed model inventory has zero actions and inspection facts show no action attached to EmergencyStopping.
issues.requirement_quote: When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state, which includes the actions "Emergency Stop" and sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The PlantUML body 'Emergency Stop' on Entry could be interpreted as an implicit action for the composite.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping missing Emergency Stop action

issues.basis: NL3; inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions transition:line:33 guard R45RouteToken == 7 effects [R45RouteToken = 0]; transition:line:22 triggers [Obstacle_Detected] effects [R45RouteToken = 7]; event_consumers Obstacle_Detected reachable_consumer_transition_refs []
issues.expected: Entry to EmergencyStopping results in sending Obstacle Detected signal.
issues.observed: InMotion -> EmergencyStopping transition:line:33 is guarded by R45RouteToken == 7 with effect R45RouteToken = 0; token is set by internal InMotion substate transitions on Obstacle_Detected event with effects R45RouteToken = 7, no signal emission on entry.
issues.reason: Model implements obstacle handling via token routing rather than an explicit signal emission on EmergencyStopping entry.
issues.requirement_quote: When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state, which includes the actions "Emergency Stop" and sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Obstacle_Detected event consumption could be read as the signal being sent on entry.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping entry does not send Obstacle Detected signal

issues.basis: NL8; exact_source_inventory.transition tr_0002 event Entry/Accelerate; inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions transition:line:15 triggers [Entry_Accelerate] effects []
issues.expected: Accelerating entry lifecycle has action Accelerate.
issues.observed: Initial transition [*]->Accelerating transition:line:15 is triggered by Entry_Accelerate event; no entry action Accelerate is recorded on state Accelerating.
issues.reason: Contract requires an entry action; model provides a trigger on the initial transition, not a state entry action.
issues.requirement_quote: The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins, marked by the "Entry/Accelerate" action.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Trigger Entry_Accelerate could be conflated with an entry action name.
issues.title: Accelerating entry not marked by Entry/Accelerate action

issues.basis: inspection_equivalent_facts.reachability reachable_state_refs state:llms_emp_feedback_final_0014:line:2, state:UnspecifiedInitial:line:9; diagnostics STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL line10; verify_facts check reachability:state:DoorsClosing:line:10 refuted; exact_source_inventory states DoorsClosing line2
issues.expected: Top-level initial pseudostate enters DoorsClosing so system starts in DoorsClosing.
issues.observed: Top-level initial transition is [*] -> UnspecifiedInitial line34; state DoorsClosing is unreachable from initial per inspection_equivalent_facts reachability and STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL diagnostic; event Closed_SendDeparted consumer transition line35 is unreachable.
issues.reason: Root reachability facts show only UnspecifiedInitial reachable from top-level initial; DoorsClosing has no incoming initial edge, violating must_enter initial_entry.
issues.requirement_quote: The system starts in the DoorsClosing state and transitions to InMotion when the doors are closed, triggered by the "Closed/SendDeparted" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: DoorsClosing state exists and has outgoing transition to InMotion on Closed/SendDeparted in source inventory tr_0001 and FCSTM transition:line:35.
issues.title: System initial entry to DoorsClosing missing

issues.basis: fcstm_model text InMotion -> EmergencyStopping : if [R45RouteToken == 7] effect { R45RouteToken = 0; }; transitions line22-24 with effect R45RouteToken =7; inspection_equivalent_facts event_consumers for Obstacle_Detected
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping entry or behavior sends Obstacle Detected signal.
issues.observed: InMotion children transitions to [*] on Obstacle_Detected set R45RouteToken=7; InMotion->EmergencyStopping transition line33 is guarded by R45RouteToken ==7 with effect R45RouteToken=0; no signal emission effect is modeled.
issues.reason: Effect property is not expressible by frozen predicates and the closed model implements token routing rather than signal emission, so the required effect is absent/wrong.
issues.requirement_quote: When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state, which includes the actions "Emergency Stop" and sends the "Obstacle Detected" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Obstacle_Detected event is declared and consumed by the InMotion children transitions, and EmergencyStopping is the ultimate target of the guarded route.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping effect is not sending Obstacle Detected signal

issues.basis: inspection_equivalent_facts transitions transition:line:15 resolved_source_ref null resolved_target_ref state:Accelerating:line:12 triggers Entry_Accelerate; verify_facts initial-entry:transition:line:15 status refuted; diagnostics INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL line15; reachability shows InMotion unreachable
issues.expected: InMotion owns an unconditional initial pseudostate entry to Accelerating.
issues.observed: FCSTM has [*] -> Accelerating : /Entry_Accelerate transition:line:15 with trigger Entry_Accelerate; verify_facts initial-entry:transition:line:15 is refuted with has_trigger true; diagnostics INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL.
issues.reason: Owner-local initial entry exists but carries a trigger, so the required must_enter initial_entry without condition is not satisfied and InMotion itself is unreachable from root.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate, moving to the Cruising substate once cruising speed is reached, as indicated by the "Reached Cruising/Cruise" signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Transition [*] -> Accelerating exists and targets the required substate, and source PlantUML shows [*] --> Accelerating : Entry/Accelerate.
issues.title: InMotion initial entry to Accelerating is conditional not unconditional

issues.basis: fcstm_model text [*] -> Accelerating : /Entry_Accelerate; reference_inspection_facts actions count 0; NL8 quote
issues.expected: Accelerating has entry phase action Accelerate.
issues.observed: FCSTM transition [*] -> Accelerating uses trigger Entry_Accelerate with no action; action inventory is empty.
issues.reason: State_action with explicit phase entry and action Accelerate is not realized as an action in the closed model; only a trigger with similar name exists.
issues.requirement_quote: The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins, marked by the "Entry/Accelerate" action.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Event Entry_Accelerate name corresponds to the NL Entry/Accelerate phrase and the source PlantUML labels the initial transition with Entry/Accelerate.
issues.title: Accelerating entry action Accelerate missing

issues.basis: fcstm_model text state Approaching definition; inspection_equivalent_facts states Approaching outgoing_transition_refs line21,24; NL9 quote
issues.expected: Approaching state includes action Send signal.
issues.observed: Approaching state has no action_fact; outgoing transitions to [*] on Arrived_Stop_SendArrived and Obstacle_Detected with token effects only.
issues.reason: No state_action is bound to Approaching for sending Send signal in the closed model.
issues.requirement_quote: In the Approaching substate, the system sends the "Send" signal and continues to approach the destination.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Source PlantUML body for Approaching contains Nearing Destination and Ready to Stop/Decelerate notes, indicating author intent for approaching behavior.
issues.title: Approaching missing Send signal action

guard_modality_aggregation.reason: S5 missing-guard issues whose author label is the condition itself (boolean expression or the requirement's guard words) describe one modelling decision and are published as one report.

report_issue_clusters.observed: The following transitions realise the condition the requirement states as a guard by writing it as the transition label, i.e. as the trigger event: (1) Accelerating -> Cruising: label `Reached Cruising/Cruise`, required guard 'cruising speed is reached' (PlantUML line 8: `Accelerating --> Cruising : Reached Cruising/Cruise`) (2) Accelerating -> Approaching: label `Approached/Decelerate`, required guard 'approaches its destination' (PlantUML line 9: `Accelerating --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`) (3) Cruising -> Approaching: label `Approached/Decelerate`, required guard 'approaches the destination' (PlantUML line 10: `Cruising --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`) In PlantUML a label without brackets is the trigger; the closed model therefore declares one opaque event named after each condition and none of these transitions has a guard. Author source: PlantUML line 12: state `Accelerating` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 13: state `Cruising` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 8: `Accelerating --> Cruising : Reached Cruising/Cruise`; PlantUML line 14: state `Approaching` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 9: `Accelerating --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`; PlantUML line 10: `Cruising --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`.
